mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS change is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in high-rate regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent inflationary pressures and an unwillingness to cut rates, causing S&P 500 forward returns to decline over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising (relative to prior month), or the interaction term (CPIAUCSL_change * FEDFUNDS_change) has a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 220), elevated price pressures lead to expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing S&P 500 forward returns to decline over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high inflation regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that supports strong corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC for UNRATE in low-unemployment periods is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer and business demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive month-over-month change, or the interaction term (HOUST_change * RSAFS_change) has a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO shows a positive month-over-month change, or the Rank IC for INDPRO growth is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.0% annualized, it signals strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 growth is below 0.03.
